function check_cascadic_mg_prolong_fused(out)
    try
        (; u, ub, rhs, rhsb, h_coarse, h_coarseb, nu, num_levels) = inputs_cascadic_mg_prolong()
        (tripcount_stack, left_stack, branch_stack, right_stack, hl_stack, hl2_stack, cl_stack, cr_stack,) = initstacks_cascadic_mg_prolong_b()
        # ---- CPU ----
        cpu_ret = cpu_cascadic_mg_prolong_b(u, ub, rhs, rhsb, h_coarse, h_coarseb, nu, num_levels, tripcount_stack, left_stack, branch_stack, right_stack, hl_stack, hl2_stack, cl_stack, cr_stack)
        c_ub = copy(ub)
        c_rhsb = copy(rhsb)
        c_u = copy(u)
        c_rhs = copy(rhs)
        # ---- GPU (fresh inputs) ----
        (; u, ub, rhs, rhsb, h_coarse, h_coarseb, nu, num_levels) = inputs_cascadic_mg_prolong()
        (tripcount_stack, left_stack, branch_stack, right_stack, hl_stack, hl2_stack, cl_stack, cr_stack,) = initstacks_cascadic_mg_prolong_b()
        g_u = CuArray(copy(u))
        g_ub = CuArray(copy(ub))
        g_rhs = CuArray(copy(rhs))
        g_rhsb = CuArray(copy(rhsb))
        gpu_ret = cascadic_mg_prolong_b_cuda(g_u, g_ub, g_rhs, g_rhsb, h_coarse, h_coarseb, nu, num_levels, tripcount_stack, left_stack, branch_stack, right_stack, hl_stack, hl2_stack, cl_stack, cr_stack)
        CUDA.synchronize()
        diffs = Tuple{String,Float64}[]
        push!(diffs, ("ub", maxdiff(c_ub, Array(g_ub))))
        push!(diffs, ("rhsb", maxdiff(c_rhsb, Array(g_rhsb))))
        push!(diffs, ("u", maxdiff(c_u, Array(g_u))))
        push!(diffs, ("rhs", maxdiff(c_rhs, Array(g_rhs))))
        push!(diffs, ("__ret", maxdiff(collect(Float64, cpu_ret === nothing ? Float64[] : cpu_ret),
                                        collect(Float64, gpu_ret === nothing ? Float64[] : gpu_ret))))
        worst = isempty(diffs) ? 0.0 : maximum(d[2] for d in diffs)
        bad = [d[1] for d in diffs if d[2] > 1.0e-10]
        out["cascadic_mg_prolong/fused"] = Dict("max_rel_err" => worst, "bad" => bad)
    catch e
        out["cascadic_mg_prolong/fused"] = Dict("error" => first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n")))
    end
end
